body:
Create a square reaction sticker sheet in a clean 3-by-3 grid. Keep the reference person's face and hairstyle consistent. Use crisp editorial cartoon drawing with a teal sweatshirt.

Use the person in the reference photo as the only character. Preserve their skin tone and recognizable facial features. Use warm colors, expressive eyes and clear hand gestures.

Exactly nine stickers, read left to right, top to bottom. Give every sticker a distinct expression and pose that clearly matches its caption. Keep the character identity, proportions, outfit and colors consistent across all nine cells. Use generous equal spacing and a simple pale background. Make each silhouette clear, with a white die-cut border. Render each supplied English caption exactly once, verbatim, in large bold lettering inside its own cell, using no more than two lines. The captions, in reading order, are: {{captions}}. No extra titles, watermarks, overlapping cells or additional text.

help.en: Exactly nine short captions in reading order; up to 28 characters each.
help.zh-Hans: 按阅读顺序填写九条短句，每条最多 28 个字符。

en.title: Your Everyday Reactions
en.description: Turn one portrait into nine expressive stickers with short English chat captions.
en.body:
## How to use

Upload one clear adult portrait. The demonstration reference is AI-generated. Keep all lettering in English.

## What to check

Inspect identity, layout and every requested caption at full size and at phone display size. This is a static image; individual sticker export is a separate workflow.

zh-Hans.title: 你的日常反应九宫格
zh-Hans.description: 把一张人物照片变成九张带英文聊天短句的表情贴纸。
zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

上传一张清晰的成年人肖像。示例参考图由 AI 生成。画面文字保持英文。

## 检查重点

核对主体一致性、构图与指定配字，并在原尺寸和手机展示尺寸检查。这是一张静态图片，独立贴纸导出属于另一项工作。
